photos_videos.note: Photos are only accessed when user explicitly attaches them to tasks. Photos remain stored locally on device.

files_docs.note: Files are only accessed when user explicitly attaches them to tasks. Files remain stored locally on device.

app_functionality.description: Data is stored locally to provide core app functionality such as task management, reminders, and template expansion.

developer_communications.description: No user data is used for developer communications.

advertising.description: No advertising or marketing data is collected.

fraud_prevention.description: No fraud prevention data is collected.

personalization.description: No data is used for personalization beyond user-controlled preferences stored locally.

encryption_in_transit.reason: App does not transmit user data over networks. All data remains on device.

encryption_at_rest.details: User data is stored in the app's private SQLite database, protected by Android sandbox and device filesystem encryption.

independent_security_review.details: No independent security review has been conducted.

secure_deletion.details: Users can delete all app data through device settings or by uninstalling the app.

data_retention.policy: Data is retained on device only. Users have complete control over data retention through app usage and device settings.
data_retention.retention_period: Until user deletes data or uninstalls the app.

access.method: All data is accessible within the app. Users can export their data at any time.

deletion.method: Users can delete data within the app, through device settings, or by uninstalling.

correction.method: Users can edit any data directly within the app.

portability.method: Users can export their data in JSON format for portability.

gdpr.basis: App does not collect personal data. All data remains on user's device.

ccpa.basis: App does not sell personal information. No personal information is collected.

coppa.basis: App does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
